outcome.title: Finding examples in pi-Base
outcome.description: Use pi-Base to find a topological space with a given combination of properties.

outcome.title: Explaining deduced properties
outcome.description: Explain why a space has a property, using theorems and the properties pi-Base deduces it from.

outcome.title: Justifying implications
outcome.description: Explain why a combination of properties implies another, given that pi-Base finds no counterexample.
